title: monogate-automation-intervention-ledger.v1
description: One file per session. Append-only: entries and findings only ever grow. See PROTOCOL.md E1 for what each kind and class MEANS -- the definitions are the measurement, not documentation of it. AMENDMENT 1 (2026-07-30): entries carry `actor`. The claim under test is about the HUMAN outer loop; a ledger that records that taste HAPPENED without recording WHO exercised it would let AI self-catches confirm the hypothesis for the wrong reason. `actor` is not required by the schema so that pre-amendment entries stay valid and append-only holds; the CLI requires it and the gate flags its absence on new entries. AMENDMENT 2 (2026-07-30): catch-class entries carry `via`. The refined question is not WHO catches -- plausibly the AI, increasingly -- but WHERE THE CHAIN TERMINATES. Every AI self-catch so far fired inside a structure a human built and ratified; that is a different event from one arising unprompted, and only `via` can tell them apart after the fact.

boundary.description: The `?` flag. TRUE means the kind was a judgement call. Boundary cases are LOGGED AND FLAGGED, never dropped -- a dropped boundary case is a silent thumb on the scale.

actor.description: WHO performed the intervention. Added by AMENDMENT 1 (2026-07-30). Absent on entries logged before the amendment -- those are 'unrecorded', which the report keeps in its OWN bucket rather than folding into any actor, because an unrecorded actor and a known actor are different facts. Required on all new entries.

via.description: AMENDMENT 2 (2026-07-30). For CATCH-class entries (correction, taste) only. `structural` = the catch fired inside a human-installed structure -- a specimen convicting, a gate refusing, a pre-registered bar objecting. `spontaneous` = it arose unprompted in open work. THIS IS THE DISCRIMINATOR: an AI catch that fires because the discipline made it fire is the discipline executing; an AI catch with no structure behind it is the outer loop genuinely automating. Cheap to record now, impossible to reconstruct later.

preventive.description: AMENDMENT 3 (2026-07-31). TRUE when the catch STOPPED AN ACT before it executed, rather than finding an error after. Promoted from a description-prefix note convention on its stated recurrence condition being met (two instances). Cheaper than any catch is the mistake that never executes.

artifact_link.description: REQUIRED. House rule 6: no claim without an artifact. A finding with nowhere to point is not yet a finding.
